_description: Normalizes phone predictions from the timit-segment / ipa_vocab training alphabet (M_seg) into the prism `text` IPA convention, so prism-style recognition eval (eval_recognition.py against `text`) is fair for models trained on timit-segment (WavLM-CTC, WavLM-FCE). Derived purely from ground-truth-vs-ground-truth alignment of the two TIMIT transcriptions (6300 utts), so it converts the alphabet only and cannot mask genuine model errors.
_decision_final_stops: Per design decision (a): prism omits certain word-final/unreleased stops (t,k,d,p,g,b) that the segment convention keeps (~2.7% of phones). We deliberately do NOT drop these from predictions — that would be a lossy, context-dependent edit. They remain as a known residual (genuine annotation difference, not alphabet), so postprocessed PER carries a ~2-3% floor above the model's true error.
_application_order: per token: drop -> split -> relabel (split outputs are already prism-convention, not relabeled again)
